title: Base Tool Framework
summary: This module defines the foundational structure for creating and managing AI tools, including their specification extraction, argument schema generation, and integration with agent-based systems. It provides utilities for converting tools to and from Langchain formats and handling asynchronous execution.

nodes.label: Extract Tool Specifications
nodes.title: Tool Specification Extractor
nodes.description: Scans and extracts metadata, including name, description, run parameters, initialization parameters, environment variables, and package dependencies, from BaseTool classes.

nodes.label: Define Base Agent Tool
nodes.title: Base Agent Tool Definition
nodes.description: Provides a base class for tools specifically designed for agents, including methods for sanitizing agent names and delegating tasks to other agents within a crew.

nodes.label: Convert to Langchain Tool
nodes.title: Langchain Tool Converter
nodes.description: Converts internal BaseTool or CrewStructuredTool instances into a list of CrewStructuredTool objects for compatibility with Langchain.

nodes.label: Generate Default Arg Schema
nodes.title: Default Argument Schema Generator
nodes.description: Dynamically generates Pydantic argument schemas for tool methods (_run or _arun) based on their function signatures, handling default values and type annotations.

nodes.label: Create Tool Instance
nodes.title: Tool Instance Creator
nodes.description: A utility function to create a Tool instance from a callable function, automatically inferring its argument schema and incorporating metadata like name and description.

nodes.label: Execute Tool Asynchronously
nodes.title: Asynchronous Tool Runner
nodes.description: Handles the asynchronous execution of a tool, including argument validation, claiming usage, and invoking the tool's _arun method.

nodes.label: Validate Tool Instance
nodes.title: Tool Instance Validator
nodes.description: Validates tool instances, ensuring they conform to the expected BaseTool structure or can be resolved from a dictionary representation.

nodes.label: Convert from Langchain Tool
nodes.title: Langchain Tool Importer
nodes.description: Converts a Langchain tool object into an internal BaseTool instance, inferring the argument schema if not explicitly provided.

nodes.label: Decorate Function as Tool
nodes.title: Tool Function Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator that transforms a regular Python function into a Tool instance, automatically using the function's name and docstring.

nodes.label: Langchain Framework
nodes.title: Langchain Integration
nodes.description: Represents the external Langchain framework, which can provide tools to be integrated or consume tools from this framework.

nodes.label: Agent Orchestration System
nodes.title: Agent System
nodes.description: The core agent orchestration system that utilizes tools, especially BaseAgentTool, for task delegation and execution.

groups.label: Tool Definition & Creation
groups.title: Tool Definition & Creation
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, creating, and decorating functions into structured tool instances, including dynamic schema generation.

groups.label: Tool Specification & Metadata
groups.title: Tool Specification & Metadata
groups.description: Handles the extraction and validation of tool specifications and metadata, ensuring tools conform to expected structures and providing detailed information about their capabilities.

groups.label: Tool Execution & Agent Integration
groups.title: Tool Execution & Agent Integration
groups.description: Manages the execution lifecycle of tools, particularly for agent-specific functionalities, including asynchronous execution and delegation within an agent system.

groups.label: External Framework Interoperability
groups.title: External Framework Interoperability
groups.description: Facilitates the conversion of tools to and from external frameworks like Langchain, enabling seamless integration and broader utility.
